title: What If You Could See Every Germ Around You?
description:
Your phone. Your toothbrush. Your kitchen sponge. What if you could see every germ on them, glowing? Here's what life with germ vision would look like: the toilet plume, the blazing sponge, the phone galaxy, the five-second rule... and why most of those germs are actually on your side.

Would you want germ vision, or would you rather not know? Tell me in the comments 👇

▶ More What Ifs: What If You Had 9 Brains Like an Octopus?

SOURCES
• Sender, Fuchs & Milo 2016: ~38 trillion bacteria vs ~30 trillion human cells
• Crimaldi et al., Scientific Reports 2022: toilet plume made visible with lasers
• Cardinale et al., Scientific Reports 2017: kitchen sponges up to 5.4x10^10 cells/cm³
• Miranda & Schaffner, Rutgers 2016: five-second rule; transfer in under 1 s
• Bourouiba (MIT): sneeze gas cloud travels several meters
• Meadow et al., PeerJ 2015: personal microbial cloud
